name: subheader
purpose: The heading of one band inside a page: an h2 with a one-line description, a copy-link button that appears when the heading is hovered or focused (when it has an `anchor`), and the band's own actions on the right. Below `md` the actions drop under the copy.
useWhen: Use Subheader for the h2 heading of one band inside a console page; for marketing pages use ModuleHeader, and for a settings band use SettingsGroup.
A band of a page that holds a card, a table or a list: Payment information on Billing, Get started on a resource, General in a create form.
A band that someone should be able to link to (`anchor`).
avoidWhen: A settings band whose guidance sits in a Hint and whose body is a card of setting rows → use `settings-group`.
related: `settings-group` — the settings band with a Hint, a gutter copy-link and an optional disclosure; use it, not this, for a band of `SettingsRow`s.
`module-header` — the marketing section heading (centred, left or horizontal); use it on site pages, this one in the console.
`copy-button` — the copy-link affordance it renders, with the `az az-link` glyph that `settings-group` uses for the same action.
bestPractices: Keep the description to one sentence; put longer guidance in the band body.
Set `anchor` on bands people link to, so the h2 takes the id and the copy-link button appears.
Keep band actions to one or two outlined medium buttons.

Help for a band: the `description` first (level A of the in-product help standard). Subheader has no slot on its title line, so it takes no help glyph and never an `Info` link: the page's one `Info` link (`ConsoleLayout.ToolsTrigger`) sits after the h1 in `PageHeader`. A settings band that needs a click-open note uses `SettingsGroup`, whose `hint` renders a `Hint` after its title (level C).

props.name: title
props.doc: The band title, rendered as an h2.

props.name: size
props.doc: Kept for compatibility: in the console type set (CT-1) both sizes render the title at 14px medium.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: Id of the h2 that a hash link targets; when set, a copy-link button appears beside the title on hover or focus.

slots.name: description
slots.notes: Rich description content (links, inline code); replaces the `description` prop.

slots.name: actions
slots.notes: The band's own actions, on the right of the copy.

slots.name: info
slots.notes: An affordance right after the title and outside the h2, before the copy-link: a help button that opens the page's `HelpPanel`.
